# Mindfully Priya

> Private transition coaching with Priya Khan, an ICF-accredited (ACC) coach and certified mindfulness practitioner, for experienced women at a midlife crossroads in work or life. Based in South London, working online across the UK. The first call is complimentary.

Priya works one-to-one with women navigating a significant change in career, identity or family life, including British South Asian women navigating duty, family expectation and identity. She also offers workplace wellbeing workshops, coaching and leadership development for UK organisations. Contact: hello@mindfullypriya.com

## Coaching

- [Midlife transition coaching for women](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/): Private transition coaching for experienced women at a midlife crossroads in work or life. UK-based and online.
- [The Reclamation Programme](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/reclamation): A private six-month coaching programme for experienced women at a career or life crossroads. Twelve one-to-one sessions with Priya Khan.
- [British South Asian women in midlife](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/south-asian-midlife): Coaching for British South Asian women navigating duty, family expectation and identity at a midlife crossroads.
- [The Reconnection](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/reconnection): Twelve private questions, about fifteen minutes, and a personal written response from Priya Khan within 72 hours.
- [For organisations](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/for-organisations): Workplace wellbeing workshops, coaching and leadership development for UK organisations. South London, Croydon and online across the UK.

## About and booking

- [About Priya Khan](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/mindfully-priya-coaching): Priya's credentials and approach.
- [Book a call](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/mindfully-priya-booking): Book a complimentary 30-minute call with Priya Khan, or arrange a private coaching session.
